# automerge-c (vendored)

The C API of [Automerge](https://github.com/automerge/automerge), vendored
for `automerge_dart`. License: MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE) (copied from the
upstream repository root).

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/automerge/automerge, directory
  `rust/automerge-c`.
- Commit: `1755d0dbd9a467cb849cf08a5c86e207835f5533` ("rust/automerge@0.12.0",
  2026-09-16), the commit that set `rust/automerge/Cargo.toml` to version
  0.12.0, the version published to crates.io. Upstream has no git tag for it.
  `rust/automerge-c` is unchanged between that commit and upstream `main` at
  `d09a2ffafb775a2bfabb3fc64f0532d26e38c76b` (2026-11-11).

## What was copied

`Cargo.toml`, `build.rs`, `cbindgen.toml` and the Rust sources in `src/`.

Not copied, because the Cargo build does not use them: the CMake build
(`CMakeLists.txt`, `cmake/`), the C utility library (`src/utils/*.c`,
`include/automerge-c/utils/`), C tests, examples, docs and the upstream
README.

## Changes from upstream

- `Cargo.toml`: `crate-type = ["staticlib", "cdylib"]` (was `["staticlib"]`),
  required by `native_toolchain_rust`; and
  `automerge = "=0.12.0"` from crates.io (was a path dependency on the
  sibling `rust/automerge` crate).
- Added `rust-toolchain.toml`, which pins the Rust toolchain and targets for
  the build hook.
- Added `Cargo.lock`, so the build uses fixed versions of the dependencies.
- Added `include/automerge-c/automerge.h`, generated by
  `tool/generate_header.dart` (see below).

## The header

Upstream's CMake build runs Cargo with `CBINDGEN_TARGET_DIR` set, so
`build.rs` writes `automerge.h` with cbindgen, then edits the header.
`tool/generate_header.dart` (run from the package root:
`dart run tool/generate_header.dart`) repeats that:

1. Replace `A_M<X>_` with `AM_<X>_` (cbindgen splits the `AM` prefix of enum
   tags).
2. Replace each `USIZE_` with `+8`, the pointer size of every target in
   `rust-toolchain.toml` (cbindgen cannot evaluate the `size_of` behind the
   `AMitems` field size).

CMake also generates `config.h` (version macros and the text indexing unit).
`automerge.h` does not include it and the binding uses neither, so it is not
generated. CMake builds with the `automerge/utf8-indexing` feature by default;
this build does not enable it, which only changes positions in text objects,
which the binding does not expose.

## Updating

Copy the same files from the new upstream commit, re-apply the two
`Cargo.toml` changes, run `cargo update` in this directory, regenerate the
header, then run `dart run tool/ffigen.dart` and the package tests.
